summary: Tested BiOracle V12 backend (11 pytest cases) and frontend (mobile 390x844). All 13 review-request scenarios pass. Backend Sovereign logic, Gemini interpretation, fingerprint heuristic, triage, stealth, history endpoints all working. Frontend renders gold-glow battery, sliders update reactively, fingerprint upload integrates with backend (loop->O verified), all required data-testids present.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: logger is referenced inside analyze_fingerprint_image (line 179) but logger is defined below at line 321 (after include_router). It works due to module-level scope but is fragile - move logging.basicConfig + logger declaration above ROUTES section.
server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('shutdown'); consider FastAPI lifespan context manager.
Empty image_base64 check happens AFTER pydantic, which already accepts empty strings; OK but consider min_length=1 in FingerprintInput for clearer 422.
App.js is a single 600-line file; consider splitting HealthBattery/AcousticScanner/FingerprintABO/EmergencyTriage/EMFStealth into separate components for maintainability.
Acoustic mic flow uses alert() for permission errors - acceptable for MVP but a toast would be cleaner.
seed_data_creation: None - tests create transient scan records via API only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All review-request features verified. Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/test_bioracle.py is reusable as regression. Frontend slider updates require React-aware native setter pattern (used Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor on HTMLInputElement) to dispatch input events properly. Mic-based acoustic scan was not E2E tested (getUserMedia); button presence + clickability verified per main agent's guidance.
